page.layout: One column of running text, with Arabic and Hebrew-pointed words inline and a few vowel signs above the lines. Page number at the head. Catchword at the right and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: 4. Gjezma, vel Gjezmon indicat literam cui superponitur cum praecedente vocali debere copulari, & sic mixtā syllabam constituere, ut Scheva quiescens apud Hebraeos : pingitur
[illegible, ~3 signs] verò sic (o) vel (o) vel sic (o) ut [illegible, ~4 letters] darbo.

Literis omnibus appingitur nisi | quie-scenti in fine post [illegible, ~1 letter]. Quiescentibus verò [illegible, ~3 letters] licet à multis apponitur, haud rectè tamen nisi radicales sint, & naturâ suâ mobiles, ut [illegible, ~3 letters] joulado, nascetur, [illegible, ~3 letters] jameno credet, &c.

5. Tefdid, omnibus literis, excepto | superscribitur, eáfque duplicat, ad modum daghes fortis apud Hebraeos : pingitur sic (w): Mauris verò seu Occidentalibus infra literam sic (ᴧ), supra verò sic (v) & subinde sic (ᴧ); vsurpatur euphoniae gratiâ, aliquando post literam vocali carentem, quae litera tunc non pronuntiatur, sed ejus vicem supplet litera sequens, per Tefdid geminata, ut [illegible, ~3 letters] wa-latta, non waladta.
Estque Tefdid hoc euphonicum triplex: Deltale, Lamdale, vel Initiale.

page.notes: Printed "nifi" and "Eftque" use long s, given here as s. Arabic words and the vowel or point signs are not legible enough to copy; they are marked illegible. The sign after "nisi |" and the sign "(o)" forms are doubtful. The mark after "post" is an Arabic-style letter that could not be read. The vowel-sign line above "verò" is not transcribed.
